luiskr.com / routes/views/project/layout / textOffset

function textOffset(c, items, idx): number

Defined in: website/views/project/layout.ts:71

Start offset for the text run at index idx: cumulative real chars of the preceding items × the per-char delay, plus the per-index step — so sequential sections cascade rather than all starting at t=0.

Parameters

c

ViewProject

The ViewProject instance — supplies textDelay via the facade.

items

unknown

Section text items (expected string[]).

idx

number

Index of this item in the section.

Returns

number

Start offset in ms (0 for non-array input).
